description: HTML helps you put words and pictures on a web page. Think of it as the labels on a school poster: this is a title, this is a paragraph, and this is a picture. Start with a tiny page. Then learn to add links, lists, tables and forms. Each lesson gives you a small job to try. You can run the HTML examples here in your browser.
versionNote: Covers the HTML Living Standard as implemented by current browsers (2026). There is no 'HTML 6'; what people call HTML5 is simply modern HTML.
whatYouWillLearn: Make your first page with a title and a paragraph
Add pictures, links and lists to your page
Build a table and a simple form
Help more people read and use your page
learningObjectives: Make your first page with a title and a paragraph
Add pictures, links and lists to your page
Build a table and a simple form
Help more people read and use your page
